scenes.tts: Why would a well-fed mouse suddenly start eating?
scenes.visual: A well-fed mouse rests beside a full food dish. Title card: Received minus predicted.
scenes.narration: Why would a well-fed mouse suddenly start eating?

scenes.tts: Researchers put a light-sensitive switch into a small group of neurons at the base of its brain.
scenes.visual: Cutaway of the mouse brain; a small patch at the base glows as a light switch icon appears.
scenes.narration: Researchers put a light-sensitive switch into a small group of neurons at the base of its brain.

scenes.tts: When they shone light on those neurons, the well-fed mouse began eating within minutes.
scenes.visual: The patch lights up; the mouse walks to the dish and eats. Label: Aponte, Atasoy and Sternson, 2011.
scenes.narration: When they shone light on those neurons, the well-fed mouse began eating within minutes.

scenes.tts: That raises two questions. Why is food worth seeking? And how does the brain learn where to find it?
scenes.visual: Two question cards: Why is food worth seeking? How does the brain learn where it is?
scenes.narration: That raises two questions. Why is food worth seeking? And how does the brain learn where to find it?

scenes.tts: Hunger answers the first. Hunger changes how much food is worth right now, and circuits in the hypothalamus are thought to help set that.
scenes.visual: A worth dial on the food dish turns up as a gauge labelled hunger rises.
scenes.narration: Hunger answers the first. Hunger changes how much food is worth right now, and circuits in the hypothalamus are thought to help set that.

scenes.tts: Dopamine neurons in the midbrain help with the second, and what they report is surprising.
scenes.visual: Zoom to the midbrain; a few dopamine neurons highlighted.
scenes.narration: Dopamine neurons in the midbrain help with the second, and what they report is surprising.

scenes.tts: They do not simply report the reward. They report how much better or worse things went than predicted.
scenes.visual: On screen: burst or pause = better or worse than predicted. At the reward: received − predicted.
scenes.narration: They do not simply report the reward. They report how much better or worse things went than predicted.

scenes.tts: Picture two bars over a cup of juice. One shows what was predicted. The other shows what arrived.
scenes.visual: Two bars over a juice cup: predicted (empty) and received (full).
scenes.narration: Picture two bars over a cup of juice. One shows what was predicted. The other shows what arrived.

scenes.tts: The gap between them is the error.
scenes.visual: The gap between the bar tops glows. Label: error.
scenes.narration: The gap between them is the error.

scenes.tts: When the juice is better than predicted, the gap is positive. The neuron fires a brief burst.
scenes.visual: Panel 1, better than expected: positive gap; a dense cluster of spike ticks.
scenes.narration: When the juice is better than predicted, the gap is positive. The neuron fires a brief burst.

scenes.tts: Now the juice arrives exactly as predicted. What does the neuron do?
scenes.visual: Panel 2: the two bars are equal height. Question mark over the spike line.
scenes.narration: Now the juice arrives exactly as predicted. What does the neuron do?

scenes.visual: The question stays on screen; a small countdown ring runs.

scenes.tts: Nothing. With no gap, there is no error, and the firing stays steady.
scenes.visual: Panel 2 fills in: steady, evenly spaced ticks.
scenes.narration: Nothing. With no gap, there is no error, and the firing stays steady.

scenes.tts: When the reward is worse than predicted, or missing, the gap is negative. Firing pauses briefly.
scenes.visual: Panel 3, worse than expected: the received bar is short; the ticks stop briefly.
scenes.narration: When the reward is worse than predicted, or missing, the gap is negative. Firing pauses briefly.

scenes.tts: If the same juice comes every trial, the prediction moves part of the way toward it each time.
scenes.visual: Same juice every trial: the predicted bar grows by part of the gap each time.
scenes.narration: If the same juice comes every trial, the prediction moves part of the way toward it each time.

scenes.tts: So the error at the juice shrinks toward zero. An uncertain reward always leaves some surprise.
scenes.visual: The glowing gap narrows trial by trial, then nearly vanishes.
scenes.narration: So the error at the juice shrinks toward zero. An uncertain reward always leaves some surprise.

scenes.tts: With learning, the burst moves to the tone that announces the juice. Good news from a cue counts as an error too.
scenes.visual: A timeline: tone, then juice. The burst slides from the juice to the tone. Label: the tone comes at unpredictable times.
scenes.narration: With learning, the burst moves to the tone that announces the juice. Good news from a cue counts as an error too.

scenes.tts: Hunger and satiety change how much the reward is worth in the first place.
scenes.visual: The hunger dial returns and scales the received bar up and down. Label: a modelling idea.
scenes.narration: Hunger and satiety change how much the reward is worth in the first place.

scenes.tts: Keep the scope. This holds for many, not all, dopamine neurons, in trained monkeys and rodents.
scenes.visual: Scope card: many, not all, dopamine neurons; trained monkeys and rodents; predictable reward timing.
scenes.narration: Keep the scope. This holds for many, not all, dopamine neurons, in trained monkeys and rodents.

scenes.tts: It describes a signal. A recording alone does not show that the signal teaches. And it says nothing about pleasure.
scenes.visual: Scope card adds: a signal, not proof of teaching; nothing about pleasure.
scenes.narration: It describes a signal. A recording alone does not show that the signal teaches. And it says nothing about pleasure.

scenes.tts: Carry one idea. Dopamine bursts and pauses report better or worse than predicted, and hunger shapes what the reward is worth.
scenes.visual: Takeaway card: better or worse than predicted; hunger shapes the worth.
scenes.narration: Carry one idea. Dopamine bursts and pauses report better or worse than predicted, and hunger shapes what the reward is worth.
